_comment: Tier-2: plane-STRAIN constitutive laws ignore THICKNESS — for thickness-design optimisation use LinearElasticPlaneStress2DLaw, and set both THICKNESS and DENSITY on the Properties. Pitfall (kratos.optimization #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both laws exist and both instantiate, so nothing rejects the plane-strain choice — the gradient is simply meaningless. THICKNESS and DENSITY are core variables. The two laws are distinguishable by class, which is the only pre-solve signal available. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
